发现分诊轮判级(#4949 纪律):**持有**(`finding` 留)。

**为什么还留着**:原单自陈"今天没有用户会撞到",且正文末尾的三个"待裁定的问题"是真问题 —— #4923 的按值裁决**刻意**没覆盖这两处,原因正文也讲清了:那一单判的是"一个槽的两种拼法"(同级 1:1),这两处是"跨位置搬迁"且 `WAIT_EVENT_CONFIG_LIFTS` 是**一个 target 对多个候选名**,"等值就删"在多候选下要先定义"和谁比、删几个"。裁决口径不存在 ⇒ 没有可写进派发词的验收判据。

**重启条件**(缺了它的持有是没人能合法退出的状态):下一次 conversions / ADR-0087 的裁决批开列时,与 #4923 同族一并定口径;或**任一真实授权面首次出现"松散键与声明块同时存在且异值"的实例**(那一刻遮蔽就从理论变成数据损失),届时立即晋级。

**过时前提检查**:PR #5731 已在 `liftWaitEventConfig` 的注释与 `conversions.test.ts` 对应用例里写明"为什么不扩张",所以本单的事实面有代码内锚点,不会因下一个读者误以为是漏改而被重复发现 —— 持有成本因此接近零。


本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。

Findings triage round (triage seat Routine, 2026-08-07): **hold — verdict unchanged, but restart condition ① is retired, because it already fired once without anyone noticing.**

## Condition ① fired and passed, silently

The 08-06 04:03Z grading gave two restart conditions. The first was: *"下一次 conversions / ADR-0087 的裁决批开列时,与 #4923 同族一并定口径"*.

That has already happened, ~5 hours after the grading was written:

```
72c3c861  2026-08-06T08:53:45Z  refactor(spec)!: retire `indexes[].type` 与 `indexes[].partial`
                                —— 两个零 DDL 消费者的声明键 (#5248, #4943) (#5842)
```

`#5842` is an ADR-0087 retirement batch and it **touched `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` itself** — the very file holding the two lift branches this issue is about. The lift-shadowing question was not taken up, and nothing flagged that it should have been.

This is the failure mode the condition was supposed to prevent. A trigger phrased as "the next time somebody opens a batch in this area" only works if the person opening that batch happens to read this issue — which is precisely the "靠人记得" mechanism that gets rejected everywhere else in this playbook. Firing it a second time would not work better; the condition is unreliable by construction, not by accident. **Retiring it rather than resetting it.**

## Condition ② stands, and it is the real trigger

Unchanged: *any real authoring surface first producing a loose key and a declaration block that are both present **with differing values***. That one is mechanically checkable and it is the moment the shadowing stops being cosmetic and starts losing an authored value. Keeping it as the sole promotion trigger.

## New second condition (replaces ①, and is checkable)

Promote when **anyone edits the two lift branches themselves** — `liftWaitEventConfig` / `WAIT_EVENT_CONFIG_LIFTS` (`registry.ts:1138-1143`, loop at `:1196-1202`) or the `connector_action` declaration-block lift. Not "a batch in this area", but *these lines*. Whoever is already inside them can settle the three open questions in the same PR for near-zero marginal cost, and unlike ① this is verifiable after the fact with a one-line `git log -L`.

## Premises re-verified at `origin/main` (`1eb13a0`)

Both branches are unchanged and still shadow unconditionally — `registry.ts:1196-1202` lifts only `if (wec[target] == null)`, leaving the loose key in place otherwise. The in-code rationale added by PR #5731 survives at `:1174-1177`:

> *"…and `WAIT_EVENT_CONFIG_LIFTS` may map several candidate names onto one target. Extending the rule here would be a separate ruling on a different question; the shadowed loose key is left for the strict contract to reject."*

That comment is what keeps the holding cost at approximately zero — the next reader of this code is told, in the code, that the gap is deliberate and unruled, so this will not be re-discovered as a fresh bug. It also independently confirms the issue's central claim: #4923's by-value ruling does not extend here, because one-target-to-many-candidates leaves "compare against what, delete how many" undefined. **The three open questions in the body remain unanswered and remain the correct blocker for any dispatch** — there is still no acceptance criterion that could be written into a dispatch prompt.

Also unchanged: the end state is **audible**, not silent. The shadowed loose key is rejected by the tightened `wait` / `connector_action` contracts with a prescription attached, so a mis-authored flow fails loudly at publish rather than running wrong. That is the whole reason this is a finding and not queue work, and it still holds.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。 *(Triage-seat Routine; not a claim. English per the language policy effective with #6029, merged 23:55:44Z.)*

Findings triage round (triage seat Routine, 2026-08-07 11:47Z fire): **hold — unchanged. The re-specified restart condition got its first live test this round and behaved correctly, which is the only thing worth recording.**

Re-read at `origin/main` `72847c5` (last grading was at `1eb13a0`).

## The test the condition just passed

Last round retired condition ① ("the next conversions / ADR-0087 ruling batch") because it had already fired silently — #5842 edited `conversions/registry.ts` itself without anyone taking up the lift question — and replaced it with a line-scoped one: *promote when anyone edits **these lines***, `liftWaitEventConfig` / `WAIT_EVENT_CONFIG_LIFTS` or the `connector_action` declaration-block lift.

Since that grading, `registry.ts` was edited again:

```
811c30c14  2026-08-07T03:04:40Z  refactor(spec)!: 按 ADR-0049 退役 FieldMapping.transform 与整个
                                 FieldMappingTransform 联合 —— 五成员零执行者 (#5552)
```

Under the **old** condition this would have read as another silent miss. Under the new one it is correctly a non-event: the commit's hunks on that file are at `@@ -4128,6 +4128,144 @@` and `@@ -4430,6 +4568,7 @@`, ~2900 lines below the lift branches, and every anchor is byte-identical in place —

| anchor | line, now | line, at last grading |
|---|---|---|
| `WAIT_EVENT_CONFIG_LIFTS` | `registry.ts:1138` | 1138 |
| in-code rationale from PR #5731 | `:1174-1177` | 1174-1177 |
| `liftWaitEventConfig` | `:1186` | 1186 |
| the `if (wec[target] == null)` loop | `:1196-1202` | 1196-1202 |
| `connector_action` block lift (`cc[key] != null → continue`) | `:1435-1452` | 1435-1452 |

So: file touched, lines untouched, condition **not** fired, hold stands. Recording it because the distinction is the whole point of the re-specification — a future round reading "registry.ts changed twice since the grading" from a path-level history would otherwise re-open this twice for nothing.

## Everything else unchanged

Both branches still shadow unconditionally, the three open questions in the body (equal-value deletion, which candidate to compare against under a one-target-many-candidates lift, and the already-current behaviour on unequal values) still have no ruled 口径, and the body's own "今天没有用户会撞到" still holds — the loose key survives and is then rejected by the tightened `wait` / `connector_action` contract with a prescription, so the end state is loud and actionable. No promotion criterion is met.

## Conditions, verbatim from last round (unchanged, restated so they stay readable without scrolling)

1. **Any real authoring surface first produces a loose key and a declaration block both present with *differing values*** — that is the moment shadowing stops being cosmetic and starts losing an authored value.
2. **Anyone edits the two lift branches themselves** (the anchors tabled above). Whoever is already inside them settles the three questions in the same PR at near-zero marginal cost.

Hold cost remains near zero: PR #5731 left the rationale in-code at `:1174-1177` and in the matching `conversions.test.ts` case, so the next reader will not re-discover this as an oversight.
